spanish: Y llegaron a Reuel, su padre, y él dijo: «¿Por qué se apresuraron a venir hoy?»

adjudication.decision: Preserve the motion toward Reuel, the apposition identifying him as their father, the explicit change to a masculine-singular speaker, and the verbal ideas of hastening, coming, and today.
adjudication.scope: verse wording; not STATUS.md done approval
